title: Crypto entering biggest consolidation phase in history, says ARK analyst
summary: ARK Invest’s Lorenzo Valente says revenue is becoming increasingly concentrated among a handful of crypto protocols, setting the stage for more mergers, acquisitions and exchange closures.

title: Tennessee county passes another ban on crypto operations
summary: A group of 12 county commissioners voted unanimously to ban mining facilities and data centers in unincorporated areas as it deals with a lawsuit by a digital asset company.

title: The US Is Making the Most Fuel Since Pre-Covid. It’s Not Enough.
summary: US refiners are turning crude oil into products like gasoline and diesel at a pace not seen since before the Covid-19 pandemic, but even that is unlikely to rein in soaring prices soon amid a historic fuel crunch.
